result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence/2M aggregate, E&O of USD 2M, cyber/privacy of USD 5M for a vendor processing relevant data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing General Provisions language. However, it goes beyond the playbook by adding a one-year post-Term maintenance period for all policies, insurer financial-responsibility standards, an additional-insured requirement, and an express own-expense obligation. Those additions are not necessary to implement the stated position. Drafting is generally professional, though applying the post-Term requirement indiscriminately to occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation is imprecise.
